parameter.label: TOP : multiList:Text
parameter.expression: SELECT DISTINCT TOP.GRUPO AS VALUE, TOP.GRUPO AS LABEL FROM TGFTOP TOP WHERE GOLSINAL= -1 ORDER BY 1

grid.expression:
SELECT SUM(VALORC) AS VALORC, SUM(QTDC) AS QTDC, NOMEPARC, CONCAT(ROWNUM ,'º') AS RANK, rownum FROM ( SELECT SUM ( (( (ITE.VLRTOT) - (CASE WHEN :DESC = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRDESC ELSE 0 END) - (CASE WHEN :REP = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRREPRED ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN :ST = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRSUBST ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN :IPI = 'S' THEN ITE.VLRIPI ELSE 0 END) ) * CASE WHEN CAB.TIPMOV = 'D' THEN -1 ELSE 1 END) * VCAB.INDITENS ) AS VALORC,
COUNT(DISTINCT CAB.NUNOTA) AS QTDC, PAR.NOMEPARC
FROM TGFCAB CAB , TGFPAR PAR , TGFITE ITE , TGFPRO PRO , TGFTOP TPO , VGFCAB VCAB WHERE (CAB.STATUSNOTA = 'L' OR :STATUSNOTA = 'N') AND ITE.USOPROD <> 'D' AND TPO.GOLSINAL = -1 AND (CAB.CODEMP = 501 OR CAB.STATUSNFE <> 'D') AND CAB.NUNOTA= VCAB.NUNOTA AND CAB.DTNEG BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND :PERIODO.FIN AND ((TPO.GRUPO IN :TOP)) AND ((PRO.CODPROD= :PRODUTO) OR (:PRODUTO IS NULL)) AND CAB.CODPARC = PAR.CODPARC AND CAB.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND ITE.CODPROD = PRO.CODPROD AND CAB.CODTIPOPER = TPO.CODTIPOPER AND CAB.DHTIPOPER = TPO.DHALTER
GROUP BY PAR.NOMEPARC ORDER BY 1 DESC ) GROUP BY ROWNUM, NOMEPARC order by 5
